name: value-arms-heldout
decision: Jerry 2026-11-11: 'All sound good' (held-out for the DEV passers T9 and T8, board #1 comment 6788114110).

tables.stac: experiments/stac-va-<arm>.json (ultra; reported only, paired with the stac-ladder tiles receipt)

gate: Per candidate, PASS iff both: (1) the self_served evaluator receipt passes (paired-normal LCB > 0 at alpha .05, variance_floor .10, point >= 0, 0 truncations, latency); (2) the JSettlers paired table: scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 4096 'pass' (one-sided LCB > 0, healthy, <= 5% excluded) and mean >= 0. Each table at alpha .05; a false pass needs both tables to pass, and the two candidates are judged separately (at most about 2 x .05^2 family-wise under independence).

power.self_served: t9 .998, t8 .830 (check_design, 768 seeds, alternative .75 x DEV point, sigma .21)
power.jsettlers: 4096 pairs, per-game SD .58 (DEV .574 / .562): pass needs a mean above about +.015; at .75 x the DEV point (t9 +.0205, t8 +.0264) power is about .73 and .90. 4096 instead of the 2048 proposed on 2026-11-10 because 2048 gives only about .48 / .66; chosen before any held-out game.

reported: STAC POMCP-TS-CR and negotiator win shares with trading, paired with the served tiles ladder (no gate); mean VP; latency
source: all three tables run the DEV code: ultra snapshot vadev-source-v1 and the Mac mini worktree catan-ai-vadevjs, both at 64260248ad1ef8d7bbacaecc7d0e3c5e8ad8e06e
consequence: PASS: supports promoting that candidate (owner's call). FAIL: planner_pv2_tiles stays served; no re-test without a new owner decision.
